_comment: GOLDEN-305, 30 epoch, DUAL-FREQUENCY probe — the golden305 posture (303 in-network GPS-
only, channel_mode single, lane_carry OFF, full golden instrumentation, WTZZ00DEU closed-
loop consumer) with the ONLY change being processing.frequency_mode: all -> dual.
30 epochs at 30 s = 900 s.
⚠️ EXPECTED OUTCOME: ZERO SOLUTION EPOCHS, exit 1.  This is a CONFIRMATION probe, not a
speed measurement.  The identical single-knob change at 63 stations
(_golden63_gps_1h_dual.json, 2026-08-04) withheld all 121 epochs and exited 1.  The
mechanism is Odijk et al. 2016 (J Geod 90:15-44) estimability: in the undifferenced/
uncombined model the satellite code biases on the FIRST TWO frequencies are not
estimable — the IF combination of (d^s_1, d^s_2) is absorbed into the satellite CLOCK and
the GF combination into the IONOSPHERE.  Two frequencies, two code-bias parameters, both
consumed.  Estimable satellite OSB appears only from the THIRD frequency onward.  This
codebase realises exactly that S-basis as the W6 IF-pin a1+a2=1, so under dual the pin
eats both bands and network.estimate_sat_code_bias (TRUE in this lineage) asks for
parameters that do not exist.  The OSB columns are null BY CONSTRUCTION, not by data.
WHAT THIS PROBE IS FOR: the deficiency above is per-SATELLITE and structural, so it must
be station-count INDEPENDENT.  303 stations is ~5x the 63-station arm and cannot add a
band.  If this run also produces zero solution epochs, that is the confirmation.  If it
somehow solves, the 63-station failure was NOT the estimability wall and the whole
diagnosis needs reopening — which is precisely why the probe is worth its few minutes.
RECOGNITION SIGNATURE (from the 63-sta arm — check these, not the absence of a crash):
- 'Network (D0) TOW' lines: 0  (section timers print per SOLVED epoch)
- Card 4 PD-safe fold INC-0: 'the DD-prior fold ran on ZERO epochs'
- Card PA: drop-and-heal fires, soft-anchors near-null PHASE-BIAS columns, 0 RECOVERED
- fatal: 'the shared datum is under-specified - a near-null W6 code-bias direction'
- every downstream instrument reports its own emptiness (0 emission passes) rather than
looking clean — the invariant-#4 shape: all tiers print ARMED, ingest is perfect,
every epoch walks, and nothing is produced.
ALSO EXPECTED, not a defect: the GPS EWL (L2,L5) and UWL-1 tiers lose their third band
and go INERT while still printing ARMED — the loader only advises
(GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:5532 is a log->info, not a guard).
IF A SPEED NUMBER IS WANTED, this is not the config: dual needs
network.estimate_sat_code_bias: false to be the CONFORMANT two-frequency model (there is
no OSB to estimate below 3 bands, so switching it off is conformance, not a compromise).
That is a structurally WEAKER producer — it also forfeits the third-frequency estimable
PHASE bias and the lane tiers — so grade it as 'a two-frequency producer', never as 'the
golden posture on two bands'.
FRESH LINEAGE ONLY: frequency_mode changes the state vector.  Own paths; never resume.
